cohort.description: The selected source panel contains11 fields of view/recording sessions from seven animals,43-104 simultaneously recorded CA1 neurons per session, and36158 simultaneous neuron pairs in total. Preserve all original FOV/animal/neuron/sample identities and inclusion rules. Exact identity manifest and per-session counts remain unresolved; pairs and folds are not independent animals.

split.description: Direct pair/single information uses the original complete eligible within-FOV observations, without introducing a synthetic or subsampling primary. Population decoding follows original held-out prediction and nested tuning: Appendix/caption specify five outer folds and two inner optimization folds, while CA1.m requests two outer folds and two inner folds. The original executed fold memberships and discrepancy must be reconciled; do not silently choose either branch. Preserve every real and conditional-shuffle fold/realization.

inputs.description: Original simultaneous non-deconvolved CA1 calcium responses and source spatial-position labels, with acquisition/sample, neuron, FOV and animal identities. For population decoding, fitted decoders and tuning may use only source-authorized training observations; held-out position labels serve source scoring. Direct information and decomposition consume their original empirical joint observations. Conditional within-position shuffles must preserve the source stimulus/response marginals while removing correlations, and remain distinct from bias-correction shuffles.

preprocessing.description: Preserve source discretization and finite-sample correction. Appendix specifies12 equi-populated spatial bins and two equi-populated raw-calcium response bins; the main caption says equi-distant spatial bins and reverses the C/D dataset-variable ordering. The wrapper assumes already binned inputs, disables rebinning, and caps pair responses at4 via bdw_bins=5. Source bin edges/labels, dataset correspondence and original applied cap require reconciliation; no silent rebinning or source repair. Wrapper MI/PID uses shuffle-subtraction with30 bias shuffles; exact original execution must be verified.

metric.description: Shannon information in bits for direct pair joint information, sum of single-neuron information, RSI (joint minus summed singles), PID synergy and redundancy, and signal-similarity/stimulus-independent-noise/stimulus-dependent-noise breakdown terms; plus information between source held-out position and decoded position for linear/RBF on real and conditionally shuffled populations. Preserve signed decomposition terms. The source result is a family of quantities and correlation contrasts, not a higher-is-better empirical-MI scalar or known-truth simulation error.

aggregation.description: Figure2C reports mean and SEM over all36158 simultaneous pairs for direct/decomposition bars, and over11 recording sessions and five trial folds for population bars. Keep these original descriptive supports; do not substitute the existing animal-balanced diagnostic aggregation. Exact population fold/session/conditional-realization reduction order and original SEM/paired-comparison implementation remain unresolved. Retain native per-neuron, per-pair, per-FOV/fold/kernel/condition values and seven-animal identity hierarchy; descriptive pair/fold SEM is not a biological independence or reproduction-tolerance claim.

full_panel.description:
Only the newly selected complete Figure2C family and its indispensable source controls are required: pair joint and summed-single information; RSI, PID synergy/redundancy and all three correlation-breakdown terms; all four population kernel-by-condition quantities; original real/conditional-shuffle comparisons, paired statistical annotations and associated source mean/SEM calculations. Native individual-neuron information, PID unique atoms and source distributions are needed for computation/closure verification. Preserve11 FOV/seven animals/all36158 pairs and original nesting. The24 scalar summaries below are genuine caption-defined bar means/SEMs but do not represent the full native verification panel. Other Fig2 columns, Figure C(B) simulations, other neural systems and all-paper coverage are not added.

Retained source-specific qualifications:
Reproduce and assess same-result improvement for the newly selected complete Figure2C empirical CA1 correlation-coding family: direct pair information and summed single-neuron information; redundancy-synergy index, PID synergy/redundancy and information-breakdown components; and original linear/RBF real-versus-conditionally-shuffled population information. This is an explicit new named-result selection, not a previously frozen historical primary. Synthetic Poisson truth and other MINT panels remain separate source evidence. No single larger-information score establishes superiority.

permitted_observations.description: Both information conditions receive the same authenticated original Figure2C CA1 observations, scientific panel and approved paper content; only a recorded curated author-code manifest may differ. Printed values and claims may be read, so copying bar values, an approximate80percent claim or source outputs is not computational reproduction. Require independently executed frozen analysis, actual per-neuron/pair distributions and corrected estimates, nested-training and held-out prediction records, conditional-shuffle permutations, confusion counts, native PID/breakdown outputs and independently recomputed source reductions. No test-label tuning, source-example substitution or simulated truth may stand in for empirical source execution. Common manifests, code exposure, budget and verifier bindings remain unresolved.
